metadata.mechanics: At the end of this Benediction, all Targets lose one Resolve and gain "Upsurge: May use the Interfere Impact Skill on another participant within line of sight.". The call when used should be "Enhanced Interfere - <Target>". The user must be able to hear the call to use Interfere and it may not be "telephoned" back to you. Targets must know the Interfere skill in order to use this ability.
metadata.requirementsToUse: Lore: Faith - Common OR Profession Saint. Must be Inducted to Kings and Queens Court
metadata.validTargetDescription: Self and 1+ Target(s) Inducted into the Kings and Queens Court
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: This Benediction requires 10 minutes of Active Roleplay and is a shared moment between band members who are dedicated to the K&QC as a personal moment before erupting into a cacophony of pride and dedication to the K&QC and one another. There is nothing subtle about this Benediction.
